body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`, research half) in `PROJECTS.md`: three more projects get a figure on their home page.

Each project gets `experiments/figure.py`, which reads only its committed `results.json` (no new results) and writes a PNG; the per-project page picks it up. A README "Figure" section names the script.
- `simdesign-kirsch`: `errors.png`, peak-stress error against mesh size (centroid vs vertex reading).
- `robofab-graspoffset`: `force.png`, grip force against offset (ball and flat pads, bounds vs MuJoCo).
- `robofab-rampopt`: `edge.png`, time-optimal edge over grid-tuned and refined trapezoid, 12 rows.

Checked: each script runs; the plotted ranges match the README figures (rampopt edge 0.05 to 0.28% refined, 0.11 to 0.88% grid); `python site/build.py` prints `ok: 393 projects, 3434 tests`; the rampopt page links `edge.png`.
